Coil Alignment-4:
# Preset: Full 4-Channel Coil Alignment
# Automatically rotates motor, switches through the 4 input channels,
# performs alignment scans, and saves results in slot 1-4 on the Coil Alignment page.

CLEAR_ALL_SLOTS
SET_SERVO on
SET_MOTOR_SPEED 20.0
WAIT_SPEED 20.0 5
WAIT 2.0

# Capture Slot 1 (Morgan A)
SET_CHANNEL AIN0-AIN1
WAIT 1.5
ALIGNMENT_SCAN
CAPTURE_SLOT 1

# Capture Slot 2 (Regular A)
SET_CHANNEL AIN2-AIN3
WAIT 1.5
ALIGNMENT_SCAN
CAPTURE_SLOT 2

# Capture Slot 3 (Morgan B)
SET_CHANNEL AIN4-AIN5
WAIT 1.5
ALIGNMENT_SCAN
CAPTURE_SLOT 3

# Capture Slot 4 (Regular B)
SET_CHANNEL AIN6-AIN7
WAIT 1.5
ALIGNMENT_SCAN
CAPTURE_SLOT 4

# Ramp down motor
SET_MOTOR_SPEED 0.0
WAIT 5.0
SET_SERVO off
WAIT 1.0
APPLY_OFFSET
FFT Capture-4:
# Preset: Full 4-Channel FFT Capture
# Automatically rotates motor, switches through the 4 input channels,
# waits for FFT calculation, and saves results in slot 1-4 on the FFT / Order Analysis page.

FFT_CLEAR_ALL_SLOTS
SET_SERVO on
SET_MOTOR_SPEED 25.0
WAIT_SPEED 25.0 0.5
WAIT 2.0

# Capture Slot 1 (Morgan A)
SET_CHANNEL AIN0-AIN1
WAIT 2.5
FFT_CAPTURE_SLOT 1

# Capture Slot 2 (Regular A)
SET_CHANNEL AIN2-AIN3
WAIT 2.5
FFT_CAPTURE_SLOT 2

# Capture Slot 3 (Morgan B)
SET_CHANNEL AIN4-AIN5
WAIT 2.5
FFT_CAPTURE_SLOT 3

# Capture Slot 4 (Regular B)
SET_CHANNEL AIN6-AIN7
WAIT 2.5
FFT_CAPTURE_SLOT 4

# Ramp down motor
SET_MOTOR_SPEED 0.0
SET_SERVO off
